question: What should we prioritize first and why?
summary: Prioritize updating POL-003 to meet SEBI's cyber-incident reporting timelines and channels first, because the circular (D2) carries high judged urgency and prohibitive severity for reporting. Next, address intraday borrowing policy gaps (D5) to ensure repayment and governance requirements are covered. Then plan depository integration work for SWP/STP standing instructions (D4) to meet phased deadlines. Finally, monitor certification-policy conflict (D3) for alignment before the September 21, 2026 transitional cutoff.

points.claim: The SEBI circular requires reporting via mkt_incidents@sebi.gov.in within 6 hours and via the SEBI Incident Reporting Portal within 24 hours and stages reports until closure; POL-003 does not yet specify these channels and timelines and the record is judged high urgency and prohibitive severity.
